aiDescription.summary: The resolution asks the Secretary of State to submit, within 30 days, a 502B(c) report prepared with the DRL bureau and the State Department Legal Adviser on Honduras's human‑rights practices to Congress. It requires detailed information on alleged abuses (arrest, torture, killings, trafficking), treatment of non‑citizens removed to Honduras by the U.S., assessments of U.S. security‑assistance risks, agreements or payments, individuals sent in 2025 and 2026, and 2025–26 meeting summaries.

description.text: A resolution requesting information on the Republic of Honduras's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

impact.summary: The resolution directs the Secretary of State, with the Assistant Secretary for DRL and the State Department Legal Adviser, to submit within 30 days to the Senate Foreign Relations and House Foreign Affairs Committees a 502B(c) statement on Honduras's human rights. It must report alleged abuses, treatment of migrants removed by U.S. agencies, security‑assistance risks, agreements, and 2025–2026 meetings.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S962-963)
